influences.name: Freddy Fender
influences.context: "Before the Last Teardrop Falls" – that was one of the first songs I remember listening to with my dad, driving around in his car on an 8-track. Listening to that as a kid and feeling really proud that there was a Latin-American man singing a #1 song, not only on the country charts, but on the pop charts. That was an important record for me and my family.

influences.name: Los Lobos
influences.context: I threw myself into situations like Los Super Seven that was a Latin supergroup with members of Los Lobos and Calexico. I threw myself into that situation, which led me to playing with all these great Cuban musicians.
